source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Specific care techniques, safety considerations, warning signs to monitor, and available community resources and support","B":"Information relevant only to the client themselves, without any caregiver-specific content included","C":"A single session with no opportunity for questions or return demonstration","D":"No specific content, since caregivers will learn through experience alone"}}
source_row.rationale: Caregiver education for a client with significant post-stroke deficits typically includes specific care techniques, safety considerations, warning signs to monitor, and available community resources and support, ideally including opportunities for questions and return demonstration.
source_row.source_name: AHA/ASA — Caregiver Education for Stroke Guidelines
